gates.name: indirect_base
gates.constant: more than half of the holders extend the base directly
gates.passes: a base class most holders extend themselves, not only through another base
gates.origin: engineering, rationale written but not measured
gates.source: mine.rs comment (an ancestor the team's base brings along is no convention)

gates.name: refines_base
gates.constant: Python: the outliers extend the general team base the rule's base refines
gates.passes: a base that is no refinement the outliers chose against
gates.origin: engineering, rationale written but not measured

gates.name: optional_key
gates.constant: most holders also call the callee without the key
gates.passes: a key passed on every call of the callee
gates.origin: engineering, rationale written but not measured

gates.name: universal
gates.constant: at least one outlier (holders < members)
gates.passes: a rule some member of the role does not follow; a rule that holds for every member is never proposed
gates.source: docs/v2/PLAN.md:148 ("shown as documentation, not as a check"; the documentation was never built)

gates.name: wilson
gates.constant: MIN_LOWER_BOUND = 0.75 (95% Wilson lower bound of holders / members)
gates.passes: a lower bound of at least 0.75: with one outlier, a role of 19 or more members
gates.source: docs/v2/PLAN.md:148; TIER-ADMISSION.md finds the bound does not predict precision

gates.name: lift
gates.constant: MIN_LIFT = 1.5; MIN_LIFT_EXTERNAL_CALL = 3.0 for calls into packages and built-ins, and directives
gates.passes: a rule the role follows at least 1.5 times (3 times) as often as all units of its kind
gates.source: docs/v2/PLAN.md:150; the 3.0 from one labelled round, docs/v2/EVAL-2026-11-05.md:70

gates.name: mandated
gates.constant: frameworks::MANDATES (a list of framework names)
gates.passes: a rule no framework the repository uses mandates

gates.name: tautology
gates.constant: the target is named after the role's folder or file kind
gates.passes: a rule that does not restate the role's name

gates.name: python_family_hidden
gates.constant: Python order rules, os.environ avoidance, calls on HTTP handlers
gates.passes: a Python rule of another family

gates.name: holders_one_file
gates.constant: ROLE_MIN_FILES = 3
gates.passes: holders in at least 3 files
gates.source: docs/v2/PYTHON.md:669 (one labelled failure: 20 tasks in two files)

gates.name: how_built
gates.constant: class-name helpers in components; the calls an exported value is built with
gates.passes: a call that is no part of how the code is built

gates.name: file_local
gates.constant: HOLDER_MIN_FILES = 3, HOLDER_FILE_DENSITY = 10
gates.passes: holders spread over enough files of the role
gates.origin: engineering, rationale written but not measured

gates.name: path_params
gates.constant: the rule follows the handlers' path parameters
gates.passes: a rule that is not the route's shape

gates.name: key_structure
gates.constant: the rule follows the tables' primary keys
gates.passes: a rule that is not the table's key structure

gates.name: input
gates.constant: the rule follows whether the handlers take input
gates.passes: a validation rule whose outliers do take input

gates.name: other_kind_outliers
gates.constant: FIELD_FRAMEWORK_SHARE = 0.9
gates.passes: a rule some outlier of which is of the role's own kind

gates.name: lint_layering
gates.constant: the linter's import restrictions
gates.passes: a layering rule not against the direction the linter states

gates.name: lint
gates.constant: the linter enforces the rule (error), or the team turned it off
gates.passes: a rule the linter does not decide

gates.name: uncorroborated
gates.constant: absence of console.*, bare Error, process.env, typing.Any
gates.passes: an avoidance something else in the repository corroborates

gates.name: call_family_hidden
gates.constant: TypeScript calls rules whose callee is no guard
gates.passes: a calls rule on a guard, or a Python one

gates.name: duplicate
gates.constant: same holders; a variant set over its members; CHILD_MARGIN = 0.05 across depths; NEAR_DUPLICATE = 0.9 outlier Jaccard
gates.passes: a rule no stronger rule of its role (or a nested role) already says

gates.name: cap_role
gates.constant: MAX_PER_ROLE = 5 (counts drafts the show policy will hide)
gates.passes: one of the 5 best-scored drafts of its role

gates.name: cap_avoid
gates.constant: AVOID_MAX_SHARE = 0.25 of --max (4 of 15): layering rules per repository
gates.passes: one of the best-scored layering rules within a quarter of --max; default-tier ones are cut too

gates.name: cap_repo
gates.constant: --max (DEFAULT_MAX_PER_REPO = 15) shown drafts per repository
gates.passes: one of the --max best-scored drafts the show policy shows

gates.name: narrowed_out
gates.constant: recounted over the members the rule is about: no holder left, or every member holds it
gates.passes: a rule still held, and broken, once exempt members are set aside (the bound is not checked again)
gates.origin: engineering, rationale written but not measured
gates.source: mine.rs `narrow`, `join_siblings`; no re-check after recount (PLAN-R14 WS-H(c))

gates.name: compiler
gates.constant: the compiler already enforces the rule
gates.passes: a rule the compiler does not check
gates.origin: engineering, rationale written but not measured

gates.name: no_table
gates.constant: a valid show table in the build
gates.passes: any suggestion, when the table parses

gates.name: no_family
gates.constant: the show table maps the rule kind to a family
gates.passes: a suggestion of a rule kind the table maps

gates.name: hidden_family
gates.constant: data/show-policy.json `hidden` (TS calls, ordering, renders; Python ordering, repo)
gates.passes: a suggestion of a family shown in its language
gates.source: PLAN-R10 §4, run dev-v3-relabel6-2026-11-10; the owner's decision

gates.name: not_admitted
gates.constant: leave-one-repo-out accept at least 60% of at least 5 labelled cards
gates.passes: a suggestion of a family admitted for its language
gates.source: PLAN-R10 §4, run dev-v3-relabel6-2026-11-10; the owner's decision

gates.name: max_outliers
gates.constant: data/show-policy.json `max_outliers` = 1
gates.passes: a suggestion with at most 1 outlier

gates.name: python_off
gates.constant: `proposals: {python: off}` in .drift/config.yaml
gates.passes: any card while Python proposals are on (the default)
